🇵🇭 Massive Fire — Barangay Lamion, Bongao, Tawi-Tawi, Philippines

On February 3, 2026, a massive fire broke out in Barangay Lamion, Bongao, Tawi-Tawi province.
According to Bongao MDRRMO, the blaze destroyed around 1,000 houses in the densely populated area. Thousands of residents were displaced and evacuated to temporary shelters.
Firefighters and volunteers battled the flames for hours, but strong winds fueled the spread.
⚠️ Authorities declared a state of emergency and launched humanitarian aid operations.
Reports mention power outages and urgent needs for affected families.
